'''Glimmet Ledd''' was a member of the [[Luurian Genetic Enclave]] and served in the [[Ministry of Science (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Republic Ministry of Science]] to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

On 14:3:2, Ledd was quoted in the Ministry's report on the response to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]' [[swamp gas]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Glimmet Ledd appears in the HoloNet News edition in [[Star Wars Insider 66|''Star Wars Insider'' 66]].
